name: Bond
description: Reveals the aura of other survivors within a 36-meter radius.

name: Leader
description: Within a 10-meter radius, other survivors cleanse totems, heal, open the exit gates, sabotage hooks, unhook, and unlock chests 30% faster; the effect lasts 20 seconds after moving away.

name: Prove Thyself
description: For each survivor within 4 meters of you, everyone repairs generators 10% faster.

name: Adrenaline
description: When all generators are completed, if you were downed or injured you instantly heal; then you gain a 50% Haste bonus for 3 seconds, followed by Exhausted for 40 seconds.

name: Quick & Quiet
description: Entering or diving into a locker makes no noise and doesn’t alert the killer. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

name: Sprint Burst
description: When you start running, you gain a 50% Haste bonus for 3 seconds, then suffer Exhausted for 40 seconds.

name: Botany Knowledge
description: You heal 50% faster.

name: Empathy
description: You see the aura of injured survivors within a 128-meter radius.

name: Self-Care
description: You can heal yourself without a Med-Kit, though 65% slower.

name: Calm Spirit
description: You don’t startle crows or scream; cleansing/blessing totems and unlocking chests are done silently, but 30% slower.

name: Iron Will
description: Without injuries or Exhausted, your pain grunts are 100% quieter.

name: Saboteur
description: Within a 56-meter radius of where the killer last hooked someone, you see the aura of hooks (including scourge hooks) and can sabotage them. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

name: Balanced Landing
description: When you fall 1.2 meters or more: 50% Haste for 3 seconds, then Exhausted for 40 seconds; stagger duration is reduced 75% and grunts from the fall are 100% quieter.

name: Urban Evasion
description: While crouched, you move with a 100% Haste bonus.

name: Streetwise
description: The first time you deplete an item’s charges you see the killer’s aura for 8 seconds; additionally, items found in chests come with 80% more charges.

name: Borrowed Time
description: When you unhook someone, they keep 10 extra seconds of Endurance and Haste after leaving the hook.

name: Unbreakable
description: Once per trial you can fully recover after being downed; additionally you recover 35% faster while on the ground.

name: Left Behind
description: If you are the last survivor alive, you see the hatch’s aura within a 32-meter radius.

name: Ace in the Hole
description: Items found in chests always come with an add-on (guaranteed at least a common one, with a 100% chance of an uncommon one); you keep add-ons when you escape.

name: Open-Handed
description: All survivors gain 16 extra meters of aura-reading range.

name: Up the Ante
description: For each survivor alive, everyone gains 3% Luck; additionally, everyone can attempt to unhook themselves.

name: Technician
description: While repairing, the generator’s noise radius is reduced by 8 meters, and failing a basic skill check no longer causes the generator to explode (it only loses an extra 3% progress).

name: Lithe
description: When performing a fast or medium vault, you gain a 50% Haste bonus for 3 seconds, then suffer Exhausted for 40 seconds.

name: Alert
description: When the killer breaks a pallet or wall, or damages a generator, you receive a sound notification and see their aura for 5 seconds.

name: Dead Hard
description: When unhooked, if you are injured and running, you gain Endurance for 0.5 seconds, then suffer Exhausted for 40 seconds.

name: No Mither
description: You start the trial injured with permanent Broken status; in exchange, your grunts are 100% quieter, you don’t leave blood pools, you recover 25% faster, and you can fully recover.

name: We’re Gonna Live Forever
description: You heal downed survivors 100% faster; when you finish healing one, you grant them Endurance for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

name: Pharmacy
description: Chests you unlock contain a rare Med-Kit, you unlock them 125% faster, and the killer can only hear you doing so from within 12 meters.

name: Vigil
description: Within a 16-meter radius, everyone recovers from the Blindness, Broken, Exhausted, Exposed, Hemorrhage, Hindered, Mangled, and Oblivious status effects 66% faster; the effect persists for 15 seconds after moving away.

name: Wake Up!
description: When all generators are completed, you see the aura of the exit gate switches; when you open one, others see your aura, and the gates open 12.5% faster for each survivor alive.

name: Tenacity
description: When downed, you gain a 50% Haste bonus, can crawl while recovering, and your grunts are 75% quieter.

name: Detective’s Hunch
description: When a generator is completed, for 20 seconds you see the aura of chests, generators, and totems within a 64-meter radius.

name: Stake Out
description: After hiding within the terror radius for 15 seconds, you gain 1 token (max 4); spending one on a good skill check turns it into a great one and grants 1% extra progress.

name: Windows of Opportunity
description: You see the aura of pallets, breakable walls, and windows within a 32-meter radius.

name: Boil Over
description: While being carried by the killer, every fall of 1.2 meters or more adds 33% to your struggle progress, you struggle 80% harder, and within 16 meters the killer can’t see hook auras.

name: Dance With Me
description: Sprinting out of a locker or performing a medium/fast vault leaves no scratch marks for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

name: Diversion
description: After hiding within the terror radius for 20 seconds, crouched and still, you can throw a rock 20 meters away that alerts the killer and leaves scratch marks in its place.

name: Deliverance
description: Once per trial, if you safely unhook someone, you can unhook yourself afterward; doing so gives you Broken for 60 seconds.

name: Autodidact
description: You start with 0 of 5 tokens; healing yourself without a Med-Kit builds tokens that each grant 15% extra progress (basic heals start 15% slower, and there are no great skill checks).

name: Breakdown
description: When you are unhooked, the hook used breaks and takes 180 seconds to repair; you also see the killer’s aura for 6 seconds.

name: Aftercare
description: You and up to 3 survivors see each other’s auras when unhooking or healing one another; lasts until you’re hooked.

name: Distortion
description: After being chased for 15 seconds, you gain 1 token (max 2); while not downed, when the killer attempts to see your aura you spend 1 to prevent them from seeing it or your scratch marks for 12 seconds.

name: Solidarity
description: When healing another survivor without a Med-Kit while injured yourself, you also receive healing progress at 70% speed.

name: Poised
description: The first time you repair each generator you see the killer’s aura for 8 seconds; upon completing it, you leave no scratch marks for 30 seconds.

name: Head On
description: After hiding inside a locker for 3 seconds, you can burst out to stun the killer for 3 seconds if they are within 2.5 meters; you then suffer Exhausted for 40 seconds.

name: Flip-Flop
description: While downed, every time the killer picks you up, half your recovery progress is added to your wiggle progress (up to 50%).

name: Buckle Up
description: When healing a downed survivor, both of you see the killer’s aura; upon completing the heal or their full recovery, both gain 50% Haste and leave no scratch marks for 5 seconds.

name: Mettle of Man
description: After taking 3 protection hits while injured, your next down doesn’t injure you; healing 16 meters or more from the killer reveals your aura to them; it also increases your chance of being the obsession from the start.

name: Better Together
description: While repairing, others see that generator’s aura; when the killer downs someone, you see the aura of the other survivors for 30 seconds.

name: Fixated
description: Walking grants you 20% Haste and you can see your own scratch marks.

name: Inner Strength
description: After cleansing a totem while injured and without Broken, hiding in a locker for 8 seconds instantly heals you.

name: Babysitter
description: When you unhook someone, that person gains 10% Haste, leaves no blood or scratch marks for 30 seconds, and you see the killer’s aura for 8 seconds.

name: Camaraderie
description: If you’re struggling on the hook and another survivor is within 16 meters, the sacrifice timer pauses for 34 seconds.

name: Second Wind
description: After healing someone without having Broken, you get it when unhooked; if you aren’t downed within 20 seconds, you heal instantly.

name: Lucky Break
description: While injured, for up to 60 seconds you leave no blood or scratch marks; healing another survivor adds 1 extra second of duration per second of healing.

name: Any Means Necessary
description: Next to a dropped pallet, you can reset it in 3 seconds; you also see the aura of dropped pallets.

name: Breakout
description: Within 5 meters of someone being carried, you gain 10% Haste and that person struggles 25% harder.

name: Off the Record
description: While generators remain and you aren’t hooked, leaving a hook gives you 40 seconds of Endurance, grunts 100% quieter, and a hidden aura from the killer.

name: Red Herring
description: Repairing a generator for just 1 second reveals its aura; hiding in a locker sends the killer a fake alert toward that generator. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

name: For the People
description: While healthy, you can instantly heal another survivor without a Med-Kit in exchange for taking damage yourself, suffering Broken for 60 seconds, and becoming the obsession (though you start with a lower obsession chance).

name: Soul Guard
description: With a hex active, you can fully recover; each time you do, you gain Endurance for 8 seconds. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

name: Blood Pact
description: While not the obsession, you and the obsession see each other’s auras while injured; finishing healing each other within 16 meters grants both 7% Haste (and you have a lower obsession chance at the start).

name: Repressed Alliance
description: After repairing alone for 45 seconds, you can block that generator for 30 seconds.

name: Visionary
description: You see the aura of generators within a 32-meter radius; completing one puts it on a 16-second cooldown.

name: Desperate Measures
description: For each injured, downed, or hooked survivor, you heal and unhook 20% faster.

name: Built to Last
description: While holding a depleted item, hiding in a locker for 10 seconds recharges it up to 99%, but reduces its total charges by 33% each time you do this.

name: Appraisal
description: You start with 4 tokens; you can spend 1 to rummage through an empty chest (up to twice per chest); you rummage chests 80% faster.

name: Deception
description: By faking a fast entry into a locker, you don’t actually enter it, the killer gets a fake alert, and you leave no blood or scratch marks for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.

name: Power Struggle
description: If you’re being carried, have 15% or more wiggle progress, and there’s an upright pallet nearby, you can drop it to stun the killer; while downed, you see the aura of upright pallets.

name: Fast Track
description: Unhooking someone grants 1 token (max 3); on a great repair skill check, you spend all tokens to grant 5% permanent generator progress per token.

name: Smash Hit
description: Stunning the killer with a pallet gives you 50% Haste for 4 seconds, then Exhausted for 20 seconds.

name: Self-Preservation
description: Every time another survivor is hooked, you suffer Oblivious for 30 seconds.

name: Counterforce
description: You start with 1 token; cleansing a totem grants another and reveals the farthest totem for 14 seconds; each token speeds up totem cleansing by 25%.

name: Resurgence
description: When unhooked, you instantly gain 70% healing progress.

name: Blast Mine
description: After repairing 40% of the generators, you can plant a 120-second trap next to one (everyone sees its aura); if the killer damages it, they’re stunned for 4 seconds and anyone watching the blast is blinded.

name: Bite the Bullet
description: While healing, neither you nor the person being healed make noise; failing a basic skill check only costs 1% progress and doesn’t alert the killer.

name: Flashbang
description: After repairing 40% of the generators, hidden in a locker you can craft a flashbang grenade: it blinds anyone who looks at the blast, but alerts the killer.

name: Rookie Spirit
description: After succeeding 3 basic repair skill checks, you see the generator’s aura while it regresses.

name: Clairvoyance
description: When blessing or cleansing a totem while not carrying an item, for 12 seconds and 64 meters you can see the aura of chests, exit switches, generators, the hatch, and hooks.

name: Boon: Circle of Healing
description: Bless a totem (merging all active blessings); within its radius, self-healing without a Med-Kit also heals others 100% faster, and injured survivors become visible to each other.

name: Boon: Shadow Step
description: Bless a totem; within its radius you leave no scratch marks and the killer can’t see your aura (persists for 4 seconds after leaving the radius).

name: Overcome
description: When you take damage, you keep your speed boost 2 seconds longer, then suffer Exhausted for 40 seconds.

name: Corrective Action
description: You start with 3 tokens (max 5); a great basic skill check grants 1 more; if another survivor fails a basic skill check, you can spend 1 token to turn it into a good one and see their aura for 6 seconds.

name: Boon: Exponential
description: Bless a totem; downed survivors within its radius recover 100% faster and can fully recover.

name: Parental Guidance
description: After stunning the killer, for 7 seconds you make no grunts, leave no blood, and leave no scratch marks.

name: Empathic Connection
description: You heal other survivors 35% faster, and injured survivors see your aura.

name: Boon: Dark Theory
description: Bless a totem; within its radius everyone gains 3% Haste (ends 4 seconds after leaving the radius).

name: Inner Focus
description: When the killer damages another survivor, you see their aura for 10 seconds; you also see everyone else’s scratch marks.

name: Residual Manifest
description: Blinding the killer applies Blindness for 30 seconds; you can rummage a chest once to guarantee an uncommon flashlight.

name: Overzealous
description: Blessing or cleansing a totem makes you repair 10% faster until you take damage (the effect doubles if it was a hex totem).

name: Wiretap
description: After repairing 40% of the generators, you can install a 120-second trap next to one (or until the killer damages it) that reveals its aura to everyone; if the killer comes within 14 meters of that generator, everyone sees their aura.

name: Reactive Healing
description: While injured, if another survivor within 32 meters takes damage, you instantly gain 50% healing progress.

name: Low Profile
description: If every other survivor is downed or hooked, for 90 seconds you make no noise and leave no blood or scratch marks.

name: Better than New
description: After healing someone, until they take damage, blessing/cleansing, healing, and unlocking chests are 16% faster.

name: Reassurance
description: Once per hook state, within 6 meters of someone hooked, you can pause their sacrifice progress for 30 seconds.

name: Hyperfocus
description: Every great basic skill check grants 1 token (max 6); each token makes skill checks appear and rotate 4% faster and grant 30% more progress on success; failing, only hitting a good check, or stopping repairing/healing removes all your tokens.

name: Potential Energy
description: While repairing, you build tokens instead of progress (max 20); you can spend them all to convert each into 1% progress; taking damage removes them all.

name: Fogwise
description: While repairing, every great basic skill check reveals the killer’s aura for 6 seconds.

name: Quick Gambit
description: While chased by the killer, you see the aura of other survivors and they repair 5% faster; taking damage puts this on a 40-second cooldown.

name: Cut Loose
description: While chased, every medium or fast vault is silent for up to 6 seconds and resets that timer while it lasts. Cooldown: 45 seconds.

name: Friendly Competition
description: After finishing a generator with someone else, everyone who worked on it repairs 5% faster for the next 120 seconds.

name: Teamwork: Power of Two
description: After finishing healing someone within 16 meters, both of you gain 5% Haste (ends 4 seconds after separating).

name: Background Player
description: When the killer picks someone up, for 10 seconds starting to run grants you 50% Haste for 5 seconds, then Exhausted for 20 seconds.

name: Blood Rush
description: While generators remain and you aren’t hooked, once every 60 seconds you can instantly remove Exhausted (disabled by performing standout actions).

name: Teamwork: Collective Stealth
description: After someone finishes healing you within 16 meters, neither of you leaves scratch marks (ends 4 seconds after separating).

name: Troubleshooter
description: While chased, you see the aura of the generator with the most progress, and dropping a pallet reveals the killer’s aura for 6 seconds; ends 10 seconds after the chase stops.

name: Made for This
description: While injured, finishing healing someone grants you Endurance for 10 seconds; while Deep Wounded, you gain 3% Haste.

name: Scavenger
description: While repairing with an empty toolbox, every great skill check grants 1 token; at 5, you instantly recharge the toolbox but repair 50% slower for 30 seconds. You can also rummage one extra chest for a guaranteed uncommon toolbox.

name: Dramaturgy
description: While healthy and running, you gain 25% Haste for 2 seconds and then Exhausted for 40 seconds; afterward one of these happens at random: another Haste boost, Exposed for 12 seconds, a rare item with add-ons, or just a scream with no effect (the same result never repeats twice in a row).

name: Scene Partner
description: Within the terror radius, looking at the killer makes you scream and reveals their aura for 6 seconds; there’s a 50% chance you scream again and see it for 2 more seconds. Cooldown: 40 seconds.

name: Plot Twist
description: While injured, crouched and still, you can lie down quietly; once per trial, while doing so, you make no noise, recover 25% faster, and can fully recover. Succeeding grants 50% Haste for 4 seconds and heals you instantly (can be reactivated once all generators are done).

name: Lucky Star
description: You make no noise in a locker; leaving one grants 30 seconds of seeing the nearest generator’s and other survivors’ auras, with no grunts or blood. Cooldown: 25 seconds.

name: Chemical Trap
description: After repairing 20%, you can plant a 60-second trap next to a dropped pallet (everyone sees its aura); if the killer breaks it, they gain 50% Hindered for 4 seconds.

name: Light-Footed
description: While healthy and running, the killer can’t hear your footsteps; rushed actions have a 10-second cooldown.

name: Champion of Light
description: Using a flashlight grants 50% Haste; blinding the killer gives them 20% Hindered for 6 seconds. Cooldown: 40 seconds.

name: Boon: Illumination
description: Bless a totem; within its radius you see the aura of chests and generators, and with a boon totem active you bless/cleanse 10% faster.

name: Deadline
description: While injured, basic skill checks are 10% more likely to appear and occur in random zones; failing one costs 50% progress.

name: Invocation: Weaving Spiders
description: In the basement next to the circle, you start a ritual visible to others who can join; completing it gives every generator 10 permanent charges, but leaves you injured and Broken. Once per trial.

name: Strength in Shadows
description: In the basement you can self-heal (65%… 30% slower) and see the killer’s aura for 10 seconds after finishing.

name: Wicked
description: In the basement you can unhook yourself; when unhooked, you see the killer’s aura for 20 seconds.

name: Mirrored Illusion
description: After repairing 20%, next to a chest, switch, generator, or totem, you can create a fake decoy that lasts 60 seconds.

name: Bardic Inspiration
description: While still, you can perform to empower everyone within 16 meters for up to 15 seconds (everyone sees your aura); roll a d20: 1 just screams with no effect, 2–10 grants 1% extra basic skill check progress, 11–19 grants 2%, 20 grants 3%. Finishing the performance extends it 90 more seconds. Cooldown: 90 seconds.

name: Still Sight
description: After standing still for 2 seconds, until you move, you see the killer’s, chests’, and generators’ auras within 24 meters.

name: Finesse
description: While healthy, your fast vaults are 20% faster. Vault cooldown: 30 seconds.

name: Hardened
description: When blessing/cleansing a totem or unlocking a chest, instead of screaming you see the killer’s aura for 5 seconds.

name: Specialist
description: Rummaging or unlocking a chest grants 1 token (max 6); on a great repair skill check, spend all tokens to grant 4% permanent progress each.

name: Eyes of Belmont
description: When a generator is completed, you see the killer’s aura for 3 seconds; each time you see it this way, the duration increases by 2 more seconds.

name: Exultation
description: Stunning the killer with a pallet upgrades your item’s rarity one tier (if possible) and, if upgraded, recharges it 75%. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

name: Moment of Glory
description: After rummaging/unlocking 2 chests without having Broken, taking damage gives it to you; if you aren’t downed within 60 seconds, you heal instantly.

name: Invocation: Treacherous Crows
description: In the basement next to the circle, you start a ritual visible to others; completing it means every time the killer startles a crow near a survivor, everyone sees their aura for 2 seconds, but leaves you injured and Broken. Once per trial.

name: Clean Break
description: After finishing healing someone while another survivor heals you, you can activate Broken; if you aren’t downed within 60 seconds, you heal instantly.

name: Shoulder the Burden
description: Once per trial, without having 2 hook states, you can unhook someone next to you on the hook: they lose 1 hook state, you gain 1, you scream, and suffer Exposed for 40 seconds.

name: Do No Harm
description: When healing someone, each hook state they have speeds up your healing by 50%; every great skill check grants 3% extra progress.

name: Duty of Care
description: While healthy, every protection hit you take grants everyone within 12 meters 25% Haste for 6 seconds.

name: Rapid Response
description: Sprinting out of a locker gives you Exhausted for 20 seconds; every time you get Exhausted this way, you see the killer’s aura for 2 seconds.

name: Apocalyptic Ingenuity
description: After rummaging/unlocking 2 chests, next to a broken pallet you can rebuild a fragile pallet in 4 seconds; you see the aura of broken pallets within 32 meters.

name: Come and Get Me!
description: When you unhook someone, crouched and still, you can make injured/downed survivors within 24 meters make no noise or leave blood/scratch marks for 15 seconds, but you scream and the killer sees your aura for 5 seconds.

name: Teamwork: Toughen Up
description: While injured, if another survivor within 24 meters blinds or pallet-stuns the killer, for 30 seconds you make no noise and leave no blood or scratch marks.

name: Conviction
description: After finishing healing someone while downed with 25% or more recovery, you can instantly recover; you suffer Broken and, after 30 seconds, go back down.

name: Last Stand
description: After hiding within the terror radius for 90 seconds, a fast vault can stun the killer for 3 seconds if they’re within 2.5 meters. Once per trial.

name: Teamwork: Throw Down
description: Blinding or pallet-stunning the killer grants injured survivors within 24 meters Endurance and sight of their aura for 10 seconds.

name: Road Life
description: While injured, without Broken, and repairing: every great skill check grants 1 token, every failure removes 1; at 4, you can spend them all to heal 100% faster until you stop.

name: ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR!
description: While still, you can play music to empower everyone within 16 meters for up to 15 seconds (they see your aura); while playing, healing or repairing has a 20% higher chance of generating skill checks. Finishing the performance extends it 90 more seconds. Cooldown: 90 seconds.

name: Ghost Notes
description: While Exhausted, your scratch marks fade 50% faster, and Exhausted itself decreases 10% faster.

name: Bada Bada Boom
description: After repairing 20%, next to a window you can plant a 60-second trap (everyone sees its aura); if the killer vaults it, it explodes and gives them 50% Hindered for 6 seconds.

name: Change of Plan
description: You start with 2 tokens; in a locker with a regular toolbox, spend 1 to turn it (with your add-ons) into a Med-Kit of the same rarity, with 100% charges and random add-ons.

name: Teamwork: Full Circuit
description: For each survivor repairing with you, good skill check zones grow 25%; repairing with at least one other, you also repair 5% faster.

name: Extrasensory Perception
description: After crouching for 4 seconds, you see auras within a radius that grows up to 44 meters, but suffer Oblivious and Blindness; standing up (or after 11 seconds) starts a 40-second cooldown.

name: We See You
description: Every time the killer sees your aura, you gain 1 token (10-second cooldown); at 4, spend them all so everyone sees the killer’s aura for 15 seconds.

name: Teamwork: Soft Spoken
description: For each survivor repairing with you, the generator’s noise radius shrinks 25%; repairing with at least one other, you also repair 5% faster.

name: Flow State
description: Each completed generator grants 1 token (max 5); each token makes blessing/cleansing, healing, and unhooking 10% faster.

name: A Place For Us
description: When healing someone, both of you suffer Oblivious; when healing the obsession, both suffer Oblivious for 30 seconds (and you have a lower obsession chance at the start).

name: Five Moves Ahead
description: In the terror radius or while chased, you see the aura of the 5 nearest pallets/windows; after dropping a pallet you start moving 50% sooner. Cooldown per pallet dropped: 30 seconds.

name: Wide Open Throttle
description: A fast vault over a pallet grants 15% Haste for 3 seconds and resets that pallet, blocking it for 60 seconds (everyone sees its aura). Cooldown: 60 seconds.

name: Lend a Hand
description: When blessing/cleansing a totem, you can grant 4 permanent healing charges to someone you’re healing (once per survivor).

name: Cross-Examination
description: In the terror radius while not chased, the killer leaves visible light marks for 10 seconds; stepping on them grants you Oblivious, which ends 5 seconds later.

name: Boon: Steadfast
description: While standing next to a totem, use the action button to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all boons. Generators within the boon's radius regress 50% slower and survivors repair them 10% faster. Survivors within the boon's radius can see the aura of the affected generators.

name: Salvation's Cry
description: Whenever the killer chases you: you see the auras of other survivors for 3 seconds; survivors who are not being chased see your aura for 5 seconds and the killer's aura for 5 seconds.

name: Fruits of Your Labor
description: Each time you complete a generator, you gain a token. Each time you finish repairing a generator, for each token you gain 5% Haste for 2 seconds and 20% healing progress.

name: Decisive Strike
description: While generators remain and you aren’t hooked, within a 60-second window, the first time the killer picks you up you can pass a special skill check that stuns them for 4 seconds and makes you the obsession (doesn’t work after a standout action); you also have a higher obsession chance from the start.

name: Sole Survivor
description: Each survivor death grants you 1 token; each token hides your aura from the killer within 24 meters. As the last one alive, you repair 75% faster and open doors/the hatch 50% faster (with a higher obsession chance from the start).

name: Object of Obsession
description: As the obsession, every 30 seconds the killer sees your aura for 3 seconds; while that happens, you also see theirs and cleanse, heal, and repair 6% faster (with a higher obsession chance from the start).

name: Slippery Meat
description: You can attempt to unhook yourself up to 6 times, with a 4% higher success chance each attempt.

name: Small Game
description: Within 12 meters, looking at a totem in a 45° cone gives a sound notification (10-second cooldown); every totem another survivor cleanses grants 1 token (max 5), and each one narrows the cone by 5°.

name: Lightweight
description: Your scratch marks fade 5 seconds faster and are spaced further apart.

name: Déjà Vu
description: You see the aura of the 3 generators closest to each other and repair them 6% faster.

name: Spine Chill
description: Within 36 meters, the killer looking at you gives a sound notification; while they are, blessing/cleansing, healing, opening doors, repairing, sabotaging, unhooking, and unlocking chests are 6% faster.

name: Hope
description: When all generators are completed, you gain permanent 5% Haste.

name: This Is Not Happening
description: While injured, great skill check zones are 30% bigger.

name: Kindred
description: On the hook, all survivors see each other; if the killer is within 16 meters of you while hooked, everyone sees them. Off the hook, you see others while someone is hooked, and see the killer if they’re within 16 meters of that person.

name: Plunderer’s Instinct
description: You see the aura of locked chests and dropped items within 64 meters; unlocking a chest has a 50% higher chance of a higher-rarity item.

name: No One Left Behind
description: When all generators are completed: you heal and unhook 100% faster, each unhooked survivor gains 10% extra Haste, and you see everyone’s aura.

name: Dark Sense
description: When a generator is completed, if the killer is within 24 meters, you see their aura for 10 seconds.

name: Premonition
description: If the killer is within 36 meters inside a 45° cone and you look at them, you hear a sound notification. Cooldown: 30 seconds.

name: Resilience
description: While injured: blessing/cleansing, healing, opening doors, repairing, sabotaging, unhooking, unlocking chests, and vaulting are 9% faster.

name: We’ll Make It
description: When you unhook someone, for 90 seconds you heal others 100% faster.
